newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Croats open fire on Moslems at Mostar cemetery.
newsitem.headline: Croats open fire on Moslems at Mostar cemetery.

text.p: A group of Croats opened fire on Moslems visiting a cemetery in the divided Bosnian town of Mostar, wounding at least four people, an international police spokesman said on Monday.

"The Croats opened fire on the group of visiting the cemetery. We have an initial report of four casualties," Alexander Ivanko told Reuters. There was an unconfirmed report that one man was killed in the shooting, witnesses said.
Ivanko said U.N. police monitors were still investigating the shooting incident which occurred at about 2 p.m. (1300 GMT) on Monday in the town centre near a former front line.

The shooting follows rising tensions over the past month in Mostar between the rival Moslem and Croat communities. Two explosions were reported overnight and armed Croats expelled Moslems from their flat in Croat-controlled west Mostar on Sunday, Ivanko said.

The violence has coincided with political battles inside the Moslem-Croat federation over power-sharing and budgets. Bosnian Moslems and Croats fought a vicious 10-month war for territory until agreeing to form the federation under heavy U.S. pressure.
